drivers.driver: Management's announced strategy remains a plan without the binding terms or distribution policy required to unlock value for shareholders [D07].
Clinical failure in ulcerative-colitis trial invalidates the prior growth-pipeline thesis and necessitates an immediate pivot to a cash-generative royalty model [D02, D05].
The company continues to burn cash on R&D while operating margins remain negative, necessitating governance intervention to stop value destruction [D02, D03].
A 13D-style escalation is appropriate as private engagement is ongoing but lacks the urgency required to protect our capital and resolve the valuation discount [D07, D08].

final.memo:
The investment case for the Company has reached an inflection point where our initial thesis—the separation of a high-quality royalty stream from a bloated operating business—is being undermined by management’s sluggish execution and continued capital commitment to a failing research pipeline [D02, D08]. While the company has acknowledged the need to divest commercial assets and refocus on oncology, these remain abstract intentions rather than a binding, board-level plan with clear milestones and a distribution policy for proceeds [D03, D07]. 

Recent clinical failure in the ulcerative-colitis trial serves as a definitive warning that the company’s R&D spend is not just dilutive, but increasingly reckless [D02, D05]. We are no longer willing to underwrite research that lacks evidence of prospective returns while management toys with the idea of a strategic refocus [D02, D06]. The persistent operating losses and cash burn are incompatible with a business that should be managed as a finite-life royalty aggregator [D02, D03, D06]. 

We are escalating our involvement to demand accountability. Any further delay in finalizing asset sales or committing to a definitive shareholder return policy will only lead to further tax leakage and overhead drag [D05, D06]. We require an immediate, public commitment to the divestiture timeline and a guarantee that excess cash will be returned to owners, rather than incinerated in the pursuit of unproven development candidates [D03, D07]. We act now to prevent the erosion of the floor while the market remains skeptical of management’s ability to execute [D04, D05].
